items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Yeah, I was on piano and Louis Valverin was a trumpet.

ctx.x: And you had rhythm, you had yourself on piano.
Yeah, I was on piano and Louis Valverin was a trumpet. And a bass. And a bass. John Porter was playing bass in that band. And Jewel Lawrence was the song entertainer.
And you had a guitar? Yeah, uh, uh, Kemper. Kemper.
